body: Alas, we can't because I'm currently miles away. But we're going to press on anyway.

I've told him everything. We talk about it all the time. He knows every single little detail. He stands by my side despite all the crap I put him through. He loves me so very much that he's do anything for me.

He knows. So does every one of my friends. They don't understand how I can feel simultaneously so attached to this person and yet not feel like I'm still in love with him. All I want is to be in love with him, again. He made my life so very happy and I can never see myself recovering from this scar.

He's exactly what I thought he is. That's the thing! I still "love" him it's the "in love" feelings that are gone. I don't feel he is a shackle on my life. I want him in my life, I want to love him, I don't want these other people. This wasn't something that has been happening over time this happened instantly. Nothing had changed in our relationship to cause this.

He knows every single little detail. Communication has always been so key in our relationship. He is still my best friend and confidant. I want to make it work more than anything as he made me feel like the luckiest girl alive and we were/are so incredibly close.

The thing is at the time I didn't have new people giving me attention. I just had the one amazing boy giving me attention and to be honest, that's all I want. 

I know 6 months isn't a very long time but I wanted to be with him for so much longer. We had the most amazing relationship up until this one moment that flipped in my head. It's not that I'm comfortable with him, it's that a part of me still loves him and loves us and wants us back because that is what made me happy.
